original_test_intent: Verify every required PCIe NIC path sustains network throughput and stability for 12 hours at 40C with 5V/3.3V rails at -5%.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Direct-connect SUT and client, install driver, configure IP, run SST network stress for 12 hours.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: Throughput above 80% of link bandwidth with stable loading and no BMC SEL error.

historical_reviews.v3: IMPROVED MANUAL ONLY; correctly exposed topology and denominator gaps, but included 12 hours versus 240-minute Machine Time as SOURCE_CONFLICT.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Operator controls chamber, rails and cabling; the approved network harness may automate traffic and telemetry.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: 40C/-5% rails, all required PCIe slots, direct-client SST, 12 hours, >80% bandwidth; Machine Time is planning.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Slot/link map, network mode, client endpoints, driver/tool versions, bandwidth denominator and approved coverage override.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Skipped slots, sequential instead of concurrent load or shorter runs are explicit gaps.

original_method: Direct-client SST procedure and 80% criterion remain the Master reference.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the project-qualified Ethernet/RoCE/InfiniBand harness selected for each link; do not mix modes.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Mapped PCIe NIC topology and selected network fabric.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Project-qualified driver, firmware and traffic-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable NIC vendor and selected traffic-tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes fabric mode and denominator explicit; it does not replace the intended end-to-end link test.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Every source-required slot/link remains in scope.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Mode, endpoints, line-rate/overhead rule and topology.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Management-link saturation and rail-margin hazards require isolation.

safety_boundaries: Do not use the management path as the stress path
Do not adjust rails without qualified control
Do not omit slots or clear logs
no_automatic_retry: Do not rerun a failed link without new approval.
engineer_owned_verdict: Network/margin engineer evaluates throughput and platform evidence.
review_improvement: Removes only the Machine Time false conflict and retains topology, mode, denominator and full-slot coverage requirements.
